# HyperFrames Registry Skill for Muse

The discovery-and-install layer for the HyperFrames video ecosystem: search roughly 400 hosted blocks and components by intent — glitch, CRT scanlines, chromatic aberration, film grain, shimmer sweeps, charts, terminal and code windows, maps, confetti bursts, caption styles — install one item or a whole tag with `hyperframes add`, and wire it into a composition: blocks as standalone sub-compositions, components as HTML/CSS/JS snippets merged into your host file; it also covers authoring and contributing new items upstream. Discovery runs locally with nothing installed and no account. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: it lives inside the HyperFrames workflow — the hyperframes CLI is required to install anything, and search queries must be written in English (the catalog is English-only). Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
